title: French aircraft carrier pre-positions for possible Hormuz mission
summary: France's aircraft carrier the Charles de Gaulle was on Wednesday heading towards the southern Red Sea to pre?position for a possible mission to restore navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, Paris said.
